sources.title: Piracy monthly report June 2025
sources.text: While underway, the crew of the tug boat saw three boats on the port side of barge, four boats on the starboard side, and one boat at the rear. Each boat had three to four perpetrators, with approximately 14 perpetrators boarding the barge. The perpetrators escaped when the general alarm was raised. Some scrap metal was reported stolen. All crew members were accounted for and not injuries reported. The incident was reported to Singapore POCC.
